subject: Executive Roundtable — Facilitation runbook, deck ownership & pre-read schedule
body:
From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: sarah.lawson@acmefinancial.com, john.doe@acmefinancial.com
Date: 2026-11-07T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Executive Roundtable — Facilitation runbook, deck ownership & pre-read schedule

Team —

Following our planning sync yesterday, I sketched a lightweight facilitation runbook and a deck-ownership matrix to get us to a clean pre-read and a tight run-of-show for the November 18 roundtable with Acme Financial. Goal here is to reduce last-minute slide edits and make sure each executive has a one-pager hook ready by the deadline below.

Primary asks:
- Confirm who will own each slide chunk in the attached DeckOwnershipMatrix.xlsx (columns: owner, slide range, key message, backup)
- Finalize the one-page executive hooks for each speaker (PDF or Google Doc) by EOD Friday 11/13
- Confirm facilitator and backstop for each session (see runbook notes)
- Travel: we should consolidate hotel blocks and estimate arrival times so ops can coordinate ground transport

Attachments: Exec_Brief_Outline.pdf (outline for pre-read), DeckOwnershipMatrix.xlsx, Facilitation_Runbook_v1.docx
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cfacilitation
HubSpot deal: HS-93284

Quick timeline:
- 11/10: finalize slide owners (owner names in matrix)
- 11/13 EOD: one-page hooks due (I will collate into a single pre-read PDF)
- 11/16: dry run (30–45m) with all presenters + facilitator
- 11/17: Ops final arrival confirmations + hotel check-ins
- 11/18: Roundtable (9:00–13:00 run-of-show)

Laura and Marcus — please review the matrix and mark owners where you already have commitments. Monica — can you confirm the hotel block and whether we can extend late checkout for the execs? Rishi — please own the dry run scheduling and send calendar invites after owners are locked.

Thanks — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Customer Platforms
Redwood Inference

-----
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: sarah.lawson@acmefinancial.com, john.doe@acmefinancial.com
Date: 2026-11-08T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Executive Roundtable — Facilitation runbook, deck ownership & pre-read schedule

Vivek — thanks for the clear asks and the matrix. I populated a first-pass of owners in DeckOwnershipMatrix.xlsx:
- Executive intro (slides 1–4): laura_bennett (will own the narrative and team intro)
- Customer outcomes (5–10): marcus_lin (I asked Marcus to tighten the ROI bullets)
- Product roadmap highlights (11–16): vivek_kulkarni (Vivek, can you confirm the 2 big bets?)
- Support & SLAs (17–20): monica_patel

Action items from me: I will draft the one-page hooks for the Executive intro and circulate a 1st pass by Wednesday 11/11 morning. Also added two notes in the matrix for potential backup presenters if someone needs to travel later.

Quick question for logistics: do we want a single consolidated dinner for the external execs on 11/17 or separate small dinners? My vote is single dinner at 7pm (easier to schedule).

—Laura

-----
From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: sarah.lawson@acmefinancial.com
Date: 2026-11-09T08:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Executive Roundtable — Facilitation runbook, deck ownership & pre-read schedule

Adding a few product notes —
- I tightened the outcomes slides to call out 3 measurable KPIs (latency, cost per inference, infra/Ops MTTR) and flagged where we need Acme confirmation on their expected baseline.
- For the dry run, can we reserve 90 minutes instead of 30–45? When we rehearse transitions it's useful to run the first 2 sections end-to-end. Rishi: please pencil 90m on 11/16 and propose two time windows.

I also uploaded a short slide pack to the drive: Marcus_Product_Trim_v1.pptx (link in the folder).

—Marcus

-----
From: monica.patel@redwood.ai
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: sarah.lawson@acmefinancial.com
Date: 2026-11-09T14:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Executive Roundtable — Facilitation runbook, deck ownership & pre-read schedule

Hotel/travel update:
- Blocked 10 rooms at The Meridian (walking distance to venue). Rates are held until 11/5 for now; I will extend the hold to 11/10 if we confirm headcount this week.
- Late checkout (1pm) is approved for two executive rooms (we need to confirm names)
- Ground transport: I am working with Ops to get a shuttle estimate and will share costs by 11/10.

Also attached: Facilitation_Runbook_v1.docx — includes facilitator cues, AV check checklist, and a small escalation script in case a presenter runs long.

Monica
Travel & Events, Redwood Inference

-----
From: sarah.lawson@acmefinancial.com
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: john.doe@acmefinancial.com
Date: 2026-11-10T13:50:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Executive Roundtable — Facilitation runbook, deck ownership & pre-read schedule

Vivek / all — thanks for the plan. Quick notes from our side:
- Confirmed attendees: Sarah Lawson (Head of Platform), John Doe (CIO), Priya Sharma (Head of Data) — Priya copied separately when travel is confirmed.
- We prefer a single dinner on 11/17 at 7pm; our execs also asked for a short pre-dinner briefing (20 minutes) with your product lead if possible. Marcus, can you do 6:15pm for 20 minutes?
- We will aim to have our internal baseline metrics and a 1-page context brief over to you by EOD 11/11.

Appreciate the logistics coordination — Sarah

-----
From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: sarah.lawson@acmefinancial.com, john.doe@acmefinancial.com
Date: 2026-11-10T16:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Executive Roundtable — Facilitation runbook, deck ownership & pre-read schedule

Thanks everyone — this is exactly the level of clarity I was hoping for. Short summary and owners (locking these now):
- Deck owners locked: Laura (1–4), Marcus (5–10), Vivek (11–16), Monica (17–20) — see matrix for backups
- Dry run: 11/16, 90 minutes — Rishi to send calendar invites with two time options
- One-page hooks due: 11/13 EOD (I will collate)
- Hotel: Monica to extend hold and confirm final rooming by 11/10 (Monica: please send hotel confirmation to Sarah once done)
- Dinner: single dinner 11/17 at 7pm; Marcus to meet with Acme for pre-dinner briefing at 6:15pm

Next steps: Rishi, please send the dry-run invite by EOD today. Monica, please confirm the hotel extension and shuttle cost. Laura & Marcus please drop your one-pagers into the Drive folder by 11/13. Sarah/Acme — appreciated on the baseline metrics; I will reply separately once I review.

I'll produce a single collated pre-read PDF after 11/13 and circulate to both teams with the final agenda.

—Vivek
